Relative speed (same direction) = 80 − 72 = 8 km/h

Relative speed in m/s = 8 × 5/18 = 20/9 m/s

Total distance to cover = 640 + 540 = 1180 m

Time = 1180 ÷ (20/9) = 59 × 9 = 531 seconds

531 seconds = 8 minutes 51 seconds

**∴ The correct answer is 8 minutes 51 seconds.**

Speed of faster train (S₁) = 80 km/h

Speed of slower train (S₂) = 72 km/h

**Formula Used:**

Relative Speed (same direction) = S₁ − S₂

Time = Total Distance ÷ Relative Speed

 
• 
 
 Train 1: 640m

 S1 = 80 km/h
 

 S2 = 72 km/h

 Total Distance = 640 + 540 = 1180 m

⇒ Time taken = 1180 ÷ (20/9)

⇒ 5 is a prime number.

• Under the scheme, the Chhattisgarh government **stipend of rupees 500 per month will be paid to students from classes 1 to 8 and rupees 1000 per month for classes 9th to 12th. ​ **
 
• **West Bengal education scheme** _An unmarried girl child who is **13 to 18 years** old and reading in class **VIII/IX/XI/XII** will get annual scholarship of Rs. 750/- if annual income of her family is upto** Rs. 1.2 Lac.**
 
• School Education and Literacy Department, Govt. of Jharkhand initiated this ambitious programme for children studying in** Govt. Schools of Jharkhand.**
